name: Introduction to Psycholinguistics
description: The course will provide an introduction to the study of language processing, its relevance historically as well as in the modern context. It will introduce language processing at two levels, namely (a) linguistic granularity, and (b) cognitive skill. From a linguistic perspective, we will discuss the processing of words, sentences, discourse, etc. From a cognitive skill perspective we will discuss how processing interacts with reading, language acquisition, bilingualism, language impairment, etc.
